# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 1999

**Ordinance Creating the Position of Cashier I**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the position of Cashier I within the Office of the Municipal Treasurer of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It defines the functions of the Cashier I and sets the standard qualifications for the position, including educational requirements. The ordinance aims to improve the delivery of basic services responsive to the needs of the municipality.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1:** Creates the position of Cashier I in the Office of the Municipal Treasurer.
    *   The Cashier I has the following functions:
        1.  Receive for liquidation all collections of taxes, dues, fees and other receipts submitted by tax collectors.
        2.  Disburse local and trust fund as instructed by the Municipal Treasurer.
        3.  Revise posting/entries in the Abstract of General and Trust Fund collections.
        4.  Review Vouchers before its payment.
        5.  Post daily entries to the General, Special Education and Trust Funds Cashbooks.
        6.  Perform such other functions, duties and responsibilities as instructed by the Municipal Treasurer.
2.  **Section 2:** Sets the standard qualification for Cashier I.
    *   Education - BS Commerce graduate or its equivalent.
